card.name: Code arguments and string openers
card.fires_on: Responds to the first token inside an opening bracket, quote or argument list in code or technical text, such as a number in a function call or the start of an escaped string. It is also seen after << operators in C++ output code.

modes.label: Number in a call
modes.description: A bare number as the first argument inside parentheses of a code or manual-page call.

modes.label: String start in code
modes.description: A quote mark or escape piece that begins a string literal in C++ output code or a quoted title.

card.plain: It fires on the first item inside brackets or quotes in code, like a number in a function call.
